reason: Appropriations bills are vector-rich for regulatory capture, agency budget redirects, and carve-outs embedded in line-item language. Without summary text, fiscal bleed patterns are opaque—but this is precisely where Prowler deep-dive audits find laundered transfers, exempted agency enforcement budgets, and market-access favoritism disguised as administrative allocation.
vectors: fiscal_bleed: agency budget redirects and TGA flow mechanics
regulatory_capture: enforcement budget starvation or carve-outs for specific actors
market_access_exploits: agency rule-writing capacity constraints benefiting deregulation agendas
defense_dhs_smokescreen: potential emergency or security language burying fiscal transfers
title: Financial Services and General Government Appropriations Act, 2027
